topic: Day 47 — carousel — Trust usually erodes through small inconsistencies, not one big betrayal

slides.text: Not one big betrayal, that's rarely the real cause.
Small gaps accumulate below the threshold of confrontation.
That's exactly why they're more corrosive.

caption:
People rarely lose trust all at once. They lose it gradually, through a pattern of minor gaps between what was said and what happened.

Follow for one of these a day.
